references.text: The command to completely destroy the Canaanite peoples and show them no mercy, parallel with the injunction not to let anyone live.
The command to wipe out all the peoples that the Lord gives over to Israel, without showing compassion.
The execution of the command at Jericho, where everything living was devoted to destruction and annihilated.
Joshua's conquest of the Canaanite cities, where he did not let anyone survive, in accordance with the command.
The continuation of the destruction of the cities in northern Canaan, where no one who breathed was spared.
Samuel's command to Saul to completely wipe out the Amalekites, based on the same principle of total destruction.
The immediate context that names the specific peoples to be devoted to destruction and explains the reason.
